tool.name: HuBMAP scRNA FastQC
tool.description: Run FastQC on FASTQ collections using the HuBMAP analysis container
tool.command: working="\$(pwd)" && input_basename="\$(basename ${fastq.file_name})" && ln -s "$fastq" "\${working}/\${input_basename}.fastq.gz" && python3 /opt/fastqc_wrapper.py "\${working}" \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} && html_file="\$(find "\${working}" -type f -name "*.html" -print -quit)" && zip_file="\$(find "\${working}" -type f -name "*.zip" -print -quit)" && mv "\$html_file" "$fastqc_html" && mv "\$zip_file" "$fastqc_zip"
tool.help: This tool executes the HuBMAP FastQC wrapper inside the `hubmap/scrna-analysis` Docker container. It accepts a collection of FASTQ inputs and produces a compressed archive containing the full FastQC output directory.
